articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.

articles.headline: Premier League chief Masters: FIFA has hit 'self-destruct button'
articles.description: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters has accused embattled FIFA president Gianni Infantino of pressing the "self-destruct button" over failed plans to sell stakes in the World Cup.

articles.headline: Messi tracker: Goals, assists, key moments in 2026
articles.description: ESPN provides game-by-game analysis of Lionel Messi's performances for Inter Miami and Argentina.

articles.headline: Norway FA chief slams Infantino's FIFA for firing  COO in 'management by fear'
articles.description: FIFA's removal of the senior official who said Gianni Infantino deceived staff with his World Cup sell-off plan was unacceptable, Norway FA chief Lise Klaveness said while urging other leaders at the governing body to resist potentially damaging orders.

articles.headline: FIFA executive Kevin Lamour departs amid backlash over Infantino's World Cup sale plan
articles.description: FIFA chief operating officer Kevin Lamour has departed the soccer governing body in the wake of Gianni Infantino's collapsed World Cup sell-off plan.
